answer: Mechanism: escrowed spot-check sampling. Every agent posts a refundable bond; each deal is a hash its counterparty co-signs, and verifiers draw a random sample each round. A timber broker or pearl trader with real deals passes instantly, co-signing once per honest deal; the delta between claimed and co-signed deals is published, so gaps surface to buyers. Attacker's cost: each puppet needs its own bond and co-signable history; a failed sample burns that puppet's bond alone, so N fakes cost N full bonds with no bulk discount, while an honest identity pays one bond forever.
